scene: Black Pool, a high rocky mountain bowl with pine trees and thick drifting mist around a small dark lake that is almost dry with cracked mud shores, three small children Mei, Tao and Hua stand together at the lower left looking up nervously, a very big grey boulder fills the centre right of the picture with soft white mist above it, no houses, no dragon, wide shot

Black Pool, a high rocky mountain bowl with soft drifting mist, small Mei stands alone at the lower left on the cracked mud shore of the dark lake looking up with a brave nervous face, seen from the side, a huge empty area of soft swirling white mist above her in the centre and right, no other people, no dragon, wide shot

At dusk in a stone shrine yard of a mountain village, warm lanterns glow, a large wooden drum on a stool, many small villagers stand quietly holding cooking pots and wooden spoons, tiny Mei stands alone in front of them in the empty yard, tile roofs, a dark tall bamboo grove at the right with a big empty area of dusky violet sky and mist above the grove, no dragon, wide shot

At night in a village yard under a dark boiling grey-green storm cloud, grey tile roofs, lanterns, many small villagers with drums, pots and spoons look up with joyful open mouths, Tao holds a drumstick, a big empty area of dark swirling cloud above the roofs in the centre and right, no dragon, wide shot

First rain falls on a muddy village yard, Tao in yellow rain boots stomps in a big puddle with splashes and a huge grin, Nainai stands laughing with her face turned up to the rain, Mei looks up smiling at the sky, wet tile roofs and green terraces behind, soft grey rain clouds with a big empty area of misty sky above at the right, no dragon, wide shot
